newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices fall slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices fall slightly at auction.

text.p: Bangladesh tea prices dipped slightly at Tuesday's weekly auction with some traditional overseas buyers absent, brokers said.
Buyers for Pakistan, Afghanistan, Poland and Russia were active, but those for Sudan, Jordan and others were absent.
However, the market could attract local blenders, which helped to stabilise the prices partially.

More than 916,270 million kg of teas were sold at the auction at an average price was 43.45 taka, down 0.37 from the previous sale. The next auction will be held on September 17 with an offer of 1.17 million kg.
